theme: chronological and regional graphic variation; matched external inscriptions
question: Does Harappa sign usage change among published period assignments, do regions differ after object-type/site-frame adjustment, and are external texts distinct from exact length/type matched core texts?
outcome: The frozen 5680-face audit has 18067 known tokens and 1879 unreadable slots. Harappa 3B–3C equal-type JS is 0.190483 bits, physical-family Holm p=.044, text-closure p=.068 on a smaller population. Four of six regional family-reference tests and one of six text-closure tests pass Holm .05. Zero of 24 time and 314 regional sign tests passes BH .05. Regional equal-type/site other-minus-within losses are .638602, .274278 and -1.067560 bits/sign; matched training-component budgets reduce these to .263461, .182233 and -.030304. Seven of 42 external objects enter exact length/type matching; adjusted surprisal excess is .650896 bits/sign, interval [-.379864,1.857194], sign-flip p=.380, Holm 1.000. The registered protocol is a Frozen evaluation; subsequent support-preserving intervals and coverage additions remain Exploratory.
challenge: Harappa has one specifically 3A face and 1095 interval-labelled faces. Region is determined by site. A 1038-face physical/text component restricts held-out support. Circular external seals have insufficient exact-type comparators. Sparse site/type cells made several primary bootstrap intervals unusable, and sparse divergence intervals lack calibration. Source checks establish site/type leads rather than row-level archaeological validation.
remedy: Keep physical aliases and exact-text closure before selection, permute complete units within exact-type/multiplicity blocks, report pair-specific support and both reference populations, retain interval allocation assumptions, compare equal-size training components, preserve failed intervals and use a separately labelled Exploratory support-preserving sampler. Keep unresolved-rights witnesses and all record-level predictions local.
retry_when: New securely contextualized Harappa 3A records or narrowed HARP interval assignments, several adequately sampled sites per region/type, independently reviewed batch/alias relations, or complete direction-resolved Gulf-type/circular-seal comparator texts. A fresh endpoint may also test calibrated sparse-divergence uncertainty under a named observation model.
